name: EPT Sticky Menu
description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT) paragraph that renders a sticky in-page navigation menu with scroll-spy, smooth-scroll anchors, a mobile toggle and second-level dropdowns.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT) Sticky Menu adds a paragraph type that renders an in-page navigation menu which sticks to the viewport on scroll. Editors add a Sticky Menu paragraph, populate it with link and dropdown child paragraphs (each pointing at a URL or an on-page #anchor), and configure sticky behaviour (enable/disable, margin-top, breakpoint, stuck class, wrap). Front-end JavaScript adds scroll-spy active-link highlighting, smooth-scroll with menu-height offset, a mobile hamburger toggle and expandable second-level dropdowns, using the levmyshkin/sticky-js library. It is a config-only child of the shared ept_core module and reuses its EPT settings field, default-widget design options and CSS generation. Part of the EPT ecosystem alongside EPT Text, EPT Carousel, EPT Tabs, and many others.
